##  Information

| Information |
| ----------- |
| Creating a new site with related location guid will create a new location with same information and it will be linked to the site which is created, so we will get different related location guid on getting the site  |
| If related invoice location guid is same as related location guid then related invoice location guid will be using the location guid created on the site |
| If related invoice location guid is not same as related location guid then the site will be created with the invoice location guid passed from the request |
| If related remit location guid is same as related location guid then related remit location guid will be using the location guid created on the site |
| If related remit location guid is not same as related location guid then the site will be created with the remit location guid passed from the request |
